extraction.canonical_text:
[Page 1]
Problem: Independent clinics lose 20 hours each week to manual follow-up. We interviewed
120 practice managers; 78% reported the same pain. Our working prototype automates
reminders for a monthly fee of $50 per clinic. A six-month pilot has 100 paying clinics and
92% retention.
